topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: We stood before the old house, the one that whispered tales of our childhood through creaking floorboards and the endless ticking of the grandfather clock. It was always a fortress of stories and secrets, now ours to sort through. The keys felt heavy in my hand, like they held more than just the weight of brass but the promise of every unopened door. I kept glancing at my sibling, wondering if they, too, heard the house breathing, felt the gentle push of responsibility. So much to uncover, so much to remember. The future stretched ahead, tangled with the past, and the air seemed to hum with the urgency of decisions to be made.
